prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a premium high fidelity mobile interface presentation for SALIDA LISTA, a Peruvian tour guide field-operations app, Spanish language. Two complete equally sized portrait phone screens side by side, thin neutral dark device frames, large legible screen content, generous outer margins, landscape canvas. One consistent buildable cross-platform design. Ivory #F7F5EF background, deep forest green #163F35 buttons and headers, warm ochre #C18A34 accents, charcoal text, subtle topographic contour textures only on map/hero, modern humanist sans serif. No purple, no gradients, no gratuitous dashboards, no tiny text, no fake safety assurances. Screen 1 title 'Mis salidas', small SALIDA LISTA wordmark with trail symbol, greeting 'Buen día, Luis', date 'Viernes, 16 de octubre'. Main editorial card beautiful subtle Andean Salkantay mountain photograph upper portion, title 'Salkantay', '5 días · 8 participantes', 'Salida de demostración', clear state 'Lista para usar sin internet'. Primary button 'Preparar salida'. Bottom nav 'Salidas', 'Pendientes', 'Ajustes'. Screen 2 title 'Preparar salida', subtitle 'Salkantay · Día 1'. Bold 'Antes de partir'. Four spacious checklist rows 'Participantes revisados', 'Ruta y protocolo guardados', 'Equipo verificado', 'Canal de comunicación probado'. Three checked, last unchecked. Amber notice 'Guardia no activada' and 'Operaciones aún no acepta el plan'. Primary button 'Guardar preparación'. Secondary 'Ver paquete offline'. At bottom no claim everything safe. Accurate Spanish typography, each screen distinct coherent composition. UI concept only, not photo of a real deployed app.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: second coherent screen pair for SALIDA LISTA, mobile field app for Peruvian guides. Generate two complete phone mockups side by side, equal thin dark frames, landscape canvas, generous margins. Consistent design bible: ivory #F7F5EF surfaces, deep forest #163F35 primary controls, ochre #C18A34 warning, charcoal humanist sans serif, subtle topographic contour background only on map, elegant large mobile legibility, safe areas. Screen 3 'En ruta', subtitle 'Salkantay · Día 2', top amber status 'Sin conexión con operaciones'. Dominant beautiful light vector topographic map with restrained green schematic trail and points labelled 'Salkantaypampa', 'Abra Salkantay', 'Collpapampa'. Clear small label 'Esquema de demostración · No usar para navegar'. Bottom panel title 'Mi grupo', '8 participantes · Luis', own location 'Ubicación sin capturar', then 'Guardia no activada' and '2 eventos guardados en este teléfono'. Main button 'Registrar evento', secondary 'Ver participantes'. Screen 4 'Participantes', '8 personas · Grupo de Luis', amber tiny clear label 'Datos de demostración'. Large '6 de 8 presentes', 'Confirma quién está contigo'. Spacious human-readable list of eight fictional names with round initials, toggle/checkmark presence on first six and empty last two: Valeria Torres, Mateo Rojas, Lucía Flores, Diego Salas, Camila Vega, Nicolás Ruiz, Sofía Castro, Andrés León. Footer 'Los cambios se guardan en este teléfono'. Secondary link 'Volver a la ruta'. No claims live tracking, no green safe label. No more screens, no generic charts, no purple.
